name: Broomfield Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: BSM, Inc. has provided custom metal fabrication and Air Quality Control/HVAC since 1954. Our custom metal capabilities are endless. No matter the project, whether it is custom fabrication or an air quality control project, seldom are jobs the same. At BSM we pride ourselves on the variety of custom projects we can offer to our residential, commercial and industrial customers. Broomfield Sheet Metal serves the Denver metro area from Colorado Springs to Fort Collins.
about:
Broomfield Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in 1954 in Broomfield, Colorado, and has operated from a 17,000-square-foot facility in Lafayette since 2002. The company is certified as a Minority and Women Business Enterprise (MWBE) and a Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBA) by the City and County of Denver. Christine Christensen purchased the business in 2008 and serves as owner and president; the original owner's philosophy — “Business on a handshake should be good enough” — still guides the operation.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication and HVAC/air-quality-control systems. Capabilities include CNC plasma cutting, TIG and MIG welding, 10-foot shear and brake forming, rolling, sawing, and a range of finishes such as powder coating, anodizing, blackening, patina, and liquid paint. The facility houses a plasma cutting machine, a large will-call area, and extensive material inventory covering aluminum, stainless steel, carbon steel, copper, Corten, galvanized, and structural shapes. The company also designs, fabricates, and installs HVAC equipment for new and existing commercial, industrial, and residential projects.

Customers span homeowners, mill shops, subcontractors, general contractors, restaurant owners, and electrical contractors across the Denver metro area from Colorado Springs to Fort Collins, with the ability to ship nationwide. Recent projects include a beer tap tower for Resolute Brewing Company, a custom steel hood shroud for a residential kitchen, and work featured in the Hensel Phelps Great Hall newsletter. The firm serves residential, commercial, industrial, and hospitality sectors.

BSM emphasizes a one-stop-shop model for general contractors, offering most metal items found in architectural specification divisions.

name: Bucks 4x4
old_description: Bucks 4x4 has been serving the offroad community since 1966. As off-roaders ourselves, we have and continue to adapt to and meet our community's needs. From a complete mechanic shop to an extensive assortment of off-road accessories. We embrace our past while building the future. Bucks 4x4 has always been a family business and is now in its 3rd generation.
about:
Bucks 4x4 was founded in 1966 in Boise, Idaho, as a family-owned business now in its third generation. It began as a mechanic shop serving the off-road community and has since expanded into a full-line retailer of off-road parts and accessories.

The company operates a complete mechanic shop staffed by experts in gears, driveshafts, lifts, tires, and wheels. In addition to selling components such as bumpers, axles, differentials, and transfer cases from brands like Addictive Desert Designs, Air Lift, KC HiLiTES, and ARB, Bucks 4x4 builds custom 4x4 vehicles, offering everything from individual parts to complete Moab-Ready builds.

Its customers are primarily off-road enthusiasts and recreational 4x4 owners, along with dealers who source parts through a dedicated dealer program. The shop serves the automotive aftermarket for four-wheel-drive vehicles, providing installation services for suspension systems, drivetrain components, and tire-and-wheel packages.

The company emphasizes its roots as off-roaders themselves, stating they adapt to meet the community's needs. Their motto, BUCKS BUILT, reflects pride in every vehicle they work on, whether it's a simple parts order or a full custom build.

name: Bueno Foods
old_description: At Bueno Foods, staying true to our New Mexican heritage is at the heart of all of our foods. New Mexico’s fertile Hatch and Rio Grande River Valleys grow the best chile peppers in the world. They are the pride and joy of New Mexican culture — the heart and soul of our cuisine. That’s why chile has been our heritage at Bueno Foods for generations – now in our 7
about:
Bueno Foods operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it has been producing New Mexican chile-based foods for multiple decades—now in its seventh decade of business. The company traces its roots to family recipes, notably Grandma Filomena’s original tortilla recipe, though no founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The manufacturer produces a range of shelf-stable and frozen items, including Hatch and Autumn Roast® green chile, red chile, salsas, sauces, chile powders, Grandma’s® flour tortillas, and a variety of tamales and enchiladas (pork, chicken, beef, cheese, and vegan). Products are sold through retail grocery channels such as Albertsons and direct to consumers via an online store that ships nationwide.

Bueno Foods serves retail grocery chains, independent grocers, and e-commerce customers across the United States. Its chile products also supply foodservice operations, as evidenced by its role as the exclusive chile provider for the Green Chile Cheeseburger Smackdown. The company emphasizes its connection to New Mexico’s Hatch and Rio Grande valleys for chile sourcing.

The company highlights its SQF (Safe Quality Food) certification, having achieved “Excellent & Exceptional” ratings in independent audits, as proof of its food safety and quality commitments. It also promotes its efforts to preserve New Mexico’s green chile crop and to deliver authentic, homemade taste rooted in family tradition.

name: Built By Newport
old_description: Since 1963, Built by Newport has grown and evolved to meet the needs of ever changing market demands.  Working with all hardwood species, we specialize in dining chairs, accent tables, lounge seating, and lighting.  Our years of experience and passion for continuous improvement allow us to provide an array of turn key services.  Whether you are in the beginning stages of bringing your concept to life or you are in need of a specific service in the manufacturing process, we can help you.
about:
Built by Newport has operated from Newport, Vermont since 1963. Originally known as NFP, the company rebranded to reflect its focus on handcrafted hardwood furniture. Over six decades, it has grown from a wood component supplier into a full-service manufacturer of dining chairs, accent tables, lounge seating, and lighting.

The shop combines sophisticated CNC technology with hand craftsmanship from experienced builders. Its capabilities span CAD design with 3D imagery, CNC production, BIFMA testing, upholstery, steel and metal accent integration, finishing, and packaging. The facility produces both complete furniture pieces and wood components for other manufacturers, working across all hardwood species.

The company serves established furniture brands and retailers, including Room & Board and Misewell. Its customer base consists of well-established firms in growing markets that require turnkey manufacturing services from concept through delivery. Wood component manufacturing remains a core service, harking back to the firm's founding years.

Built by Newport emphasizes continuous improvement, blending modern technology with artisanal skill. The firm cites its ability to execute previously impossible designs through CNC innovation while maintaining hand-finishing quality. Turnkey services — from design validation to damage-free packaging — are positioned as its key differentiator.

name: C H Babb Co Inc
old_description: BABBCO brings the world’s finest custom tunnel ovens to bakeries around the world—from small, wholesale bakeries to the biggest, most widely known names in food. We design and build 8 types of precision-engineered tunnel ovens and a full range of custom conveyors—all from our state-of-the-art manufacturing headquarters located near Boston, Massachusetts.
about:
BABBCO, founded in 1918 by Charles Babb, is headquartered in Raynham, Massachusetts, near Boston. The company remains family-owned, now guided by fourth-generation leader William Foran, Charles Babb's great-grandson. It began serving growing bakeries in the northeastern United States with a philosophy of asking customers what they want rather than telling them.

The company designs, builds, and delivers custom-crafted tunnel ovens and conveyors from a 75,000-square-foot manufacturing facility. It offers eight major types of industrial tunnel ovens—including direct-fired, indirect-fired, air impingement, infrared, radiant-tube, thermal-oil, electric, dual-fuel, and hybrid configurations—all built on a modular platform that simplifies configuration, installation, and future modification. An on-site Innovation Center allows customers to test products on BABBCO ovens before purchase. The product range also includes final proofers and complete turnkey baking systems.

BABBCO serves commercial bakeries of all sizes, from small wholesale operations to the largest globally recognized food brands. Its customer base spans the food processing industry, with installations worldwide.

The company's founding principle—listening to customer needs—drives its reputation for providing oven solutions rather than just products. BABBCO emphasizes the combination of global technical resources with the flexibility and craftsmanship of a family business, investing continuously in new baking methods and technologies to improve quality, capacity, uptime, and environmental impact.

In-house engineering support provides design consultation and development, while assembly and logistics services extend the offering beyond molding. The facility houses equipment for all three core processes, enabling production of a wide variety of plastic parts.

CBM Plastics serves customers across a broad range of industries, though the company does not publicly list specific sectors. The company emphasizes a partnership model, stating that its primary goal is to empower partners to find and sustain success through effective, reliable product lines. name: CF woodworks
old_description: Welcome to CF Woodworks LLC. We specialize in custom epoxy river tables, residential and commercial bar creation, and epoxy interior decor. We have been creating custom furniture since 2019. Check us out on
about:
CF Woodworks LLC operates from Marlboro Township, New Jersey, where it was founded in 2019 by Chris, who began the venture as a personal hobby. After completing his first epoxy river table, he listed it on Facebook Marketplace and sold it within days, prompting him to turn the craft into a full-time business.

The shop produces custom epoxy river tables, residential and commercial bars—including whiskey barrel bars—epoxy interior decor, charcuterie boards, wedding bouquet preservation castings, and themed serving boards. A SlabMizer mill flattens wood slabs up to 15 feet long and 55 inches wide, a capability the company notes is rare in Monmouth County. The facility also handles live-edge dining tables, benches, coasters, and other small gift items sold through an Etsy storefront.

Customers range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind dining pieces to hospitality operators outfitting bars and restaurants. Wedding parties commission bouquet castings, while gift buyers purchase themed boards and coasters online. Testimonials cite a custom barrel bar and coffee table for a residential client, a live-edge walnut table and bench for another homeowner, and a commercial bar project delivered and installed by the team.

Chris describes the work as more than woodworking, emphasizing artistic detail and personal pride in each piece. The company highlights its slab-flattening capacity and the ability to deliver and install finished pieces as distinguishing factors.
